purpose: 原表头命名与当季日期行实际几何交叉定位当前审批列；不固定列号/不从后来表补，无法可靠读取则未知
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import json,hashlib,re,pdfplumber
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_conditions_source_v1';source=root/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_source_qualification_v1'
now=lambda:datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def readj(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save(n,o):
 p=out/n;assert not p.exists(),'原件保持不覆盖'
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def ident(p):
 b=p.read_bytes();return {'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
proto=readj(out/'protocol.json')
current={x['quarter']:x for x in readj(source/'全部29当前原字段方法_目视补全_v1_0_1.json')['targets']}
pagesby={x['quarter']:x for x in readj(source/'全部29原问卷全文与目标当前值方法.json')['all_original_pages_full_text']}
records=[]
for qq in proto['target_quarters']:
 q=qq.replace('-','');parent=current[q];p=root/parent['pdf']['path'];assert ident(p)['sha256']==parent['pdf']['sha256']
 rec={'quarter':q,'pdf':ident(p),'original_publication_display':parent['original_publication_display'],'original_pdf_metadata':parent['original_pdf_metadata'],
 'known_later_file_than_displayed_original_release':parent['known_later_file_than_displayed_original_release'],'source_current_title_qualified':parent['current_requested_title_in_original_text'],
 'target_field':'银行贷款审批指数','unit':'百分比','named_current_value_percent':None,'automatic_current_header_row_method_qualified':False,
 'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'original_response_collection_start':'UNKNOWN','original_response_collection_end':'UNKNOWN',
 'candidate_cells':[],'original_methods':[],'read_method':'原当前表头定位及原当季日期行几何交叉，未按固定列号猜字段'}
 with pdfplumber.open(p) as pdf:
  pg=pdf.pages[2];dates=pg.search(re.escape(q[:4])+r'\.Q'+q[-1],regex=True)
  exactdates=[x for x in dates if x['text']==q[:4]+'.Q'+q[-1]]
  rec['current_quarter_row_date_locations']=[{k:v for k,v in x.items() if k!='chars'} for x in exactdates]
  rec['table_page_1based']=3
  tables=pg.find_tables()
  rec['original_table_count']=len(tables)
  for table in tables:
   data=table.extract()
   if not data:continue
   header=data[0]
   for col,label in enumerate(header):
    text=re.sub(r'\s+','',label or '')
    if not re.search(r'银.*行.*贷.*款.*审.*批.*指.*数',text):continue
    cell=table.rows[0].cells[col]
    if not cell:continue
    rec['original_header_label']=label
    rec['original_header_cell_bbox']=list(cell)
    rec['original_grid_column_index']=col
    rec['original_grid_header_count']=len(header)
    for date in exactdates:
     center=(date['top']+date['bottom'])/2
     half=(date['bottom']-date['top'])/2+2
     crop=pg.crop((cell[0],center-half,cell[2],center+half))
     valtext=(crop.extract_text(x_tolerance=1,y_tolerance=2) or '').strip()
     values=re.findall(r'(?<![0-9.])([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)(?![0-9.])',valtext)
     rec['candidate_cells'].append({'raw_original_cell_text':valtext,'original_crop_bbox':[cell[0],center-half,cell[2],center+half],'values':values,'matching_current_quarter_date':date['text']})
  fullpages=pagesby[q]['all_pages_full_text']
  for pg0 in fullpages:
   body=re.sub(r'\s+','',pg0['text'])
   for m in re.finditer(r'银行贷款审批指数[：:]',body):
    ctx=body[max(0,m.start()-20):m.end()+270]
    rec['original_methods'].append({'pdf_page_1based':pg0['pdf_page_1based'],'context':ctx})
  methodok=any(all(x in z['context'] for x in ['审批条件','放松','基本不变','0.5']) for z in rec['original_methods'])
  rec['original_current_method_explicit']=methodok
  possible=[]
  for c in rec['candidate_cells']:
   if len(c['values'])==1 and 0<=float(c['values'][0])<=100:possible.append(float(c['values'][0]))
  if len(possible)==1 and len(exactdates)==1 and methodok:
   rec['named_current_value_percent']=possible[0];rec['automatic_current_header_row_method_qualified']=True
  if not rec['automatic_current_header_row_method_qualified']:rec['manual_same_original_page_required']=True
 records.append(rec)
 print('原当前审批',q,'数值',rec['named_current_value_percent'],'方法',methodok,'当季行',len(rec['current_quarter_row_date_locations']),'原头',rec.get('original_grid_column_index'),'合格',rec['automatic_current_header_row_method_qualified'],flush=True)
save('全部29审批原表头与当前季度行_自动读取原件.json',{'study_id':proto['study_id'],'completed_at':now(),'targets':records,
 'full_targets_kept':29,'automatic_qualified':sum(z['automatic_current_header_row_method_qualified'] for z in records),
 'same_original_manual_required':[z['quarter'] for z in records if not z['automatic_current_header_row_method_qualified']],
 'no_later_report_quotes_or_other_columns_used':True,'new_network_requests':0,'new_equity_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0})
print('原审批列读取结束，需要同原页核对',[z['quarter'] for z in records if not z['automatic_current_header_row_method_qualified']],flush=True)
